title: Claude Code VSCode coexistence with Codex

tasks.title: Install CLAUDE.md instructions surface coexisting with Codex
tasks.goal: Provide a supported claude-code adapter that installs CLAUDE.md so Claude Code and Codex can drive the same repository in VSCode without conflicting files, keeping core/ independent from .claude/.

agentGoal.draft: /goal Add Claude Code VSCode compatibility coexisting with Codex through a CLAUDE.md instructions surface verified by doctor, adapter validation and regression tests.
agentGoal.outcome: The claude-code adapter installs only CLAUDE.md with backup support, the repository root has a CLAUDE.md mirroring the AGENTS.md source order, and installing codex plus claude-code into the same target leaves .codex/ and AGENTS.md intact.
agentGoal.verificationSurface: npm run doctor, npm run validate:adapters, npm test, npm run validate and docs/REVIEW.md evidence
constraints: Do not make core/ depend on .claude/ or CLAUDE.md.
Do not create .claude/ agents or skills generation in this slice.
agentGoal.iterationPolicy: Use the smallest change that satisfies the failing verification.
agentGoal.blockedStopCondition: Stop if coexistence cannot be proven without touching .codex/ or AGENTS.md.

acceptanceCriteria: The claude-code adapter installs CLAUDE.md without modifying AGENTS.md or .codex/ in the same target.
The repository root CLAUDE.md mirrors the AGENTS.md source order for Claude Code in VSCode.
Adapter README, mapping and template declare the supported CLAUDE.md mapping and Codex coexistence.
SPEC, PLAN, architecture, adapter and IDE compatibility docs reflect the Claude Code slice without stale placeholder claims.

evidence.criterion: The claude-code adapter installs CLAUDE.md without modifying AGENTS.md or .codex/ in the same target.
evidence.result: 40 tests passed, including the claude-code coexistence regression that installs codex then claude-code into one target and asserts .codex/config.toml and AGENTS.md stay byte-identical.

evidence.criterion: The repository root CLAUDE.md mirrors the AGENTS.md source order for Claude Code in VSCode.
evidence.result: AgentOS doctor passed with CLAUDE.md and adapters/claude-code/templates/CLAUDE.md added to the required surfaces.

evidence.criterion: Adapter README, mapping and template declare the supported CLAUDE.md mapping and Codex coexistence.
evidence.result: Adapter validation passed with claude-code README, mapping and template checks for CLAUDE.md, coexistence and backup guidance.

evidence.criterion: SPEC, PLAN, architecture, adapter and IDE compatibility docs reflect the Claude Code slice without stale placeholder claims.
evidence.result: Full validation passed, covering templates, context ranges, state, secrets, edit scope, workflows, adapters, docs, license and the test suite after the documentation updates.
